candidates.claim: Late older-period revisions overwrite newer periods in fundamentals_asof
candidates.confidence: high for static rejection of claim on valid non-null uniquely keyed rows
candidates.reason: Events are processed in available_date order, breaking same-date ties by period_end. The running best key is lexicographic (period_end,available_date). Once newer period wins, a later revision of older period cannot exceed it. Each event stores only the running best then; forward-fill cannot expose a future event earlier.
